headline: The Monitoring & Admin area covers a dedicated Monitoring section of the app with sub-pages for system overview, security events, MCP call history, action logs, agent status and several admin tabs; of its 10 tickets marked as released, 2 are backed by the code that was read and 8 could not be confirmed from the portion of the code examined.
what_is_there: The code shows a Monitoring section wired into the app's main navigation that loads on demand and holds multiple sub-pages, plus configuration that names Security Events, MCP History, Action Logs and Agent Status as monitoring tabs and controls which of them a sub-administrator can see. There is also a dedicated tool-governance setting explicitly tied to a Tools tab under Monitoring, supporting the Agent Status and Tools Admin tickets.
what_is_unclear: The file that actually builds the Monitoring pages was not among the code the analysis retrieved, so the content and behaviour of the individual pages — the overview health metrics, real-time security alerts, MCP call history, log filtering, sandbox capacity management, icon management and skill create/edit/delete — could not be checked either way. Nothing in the code contradicted any of these tickets; they simply were not settled.
suggested_action: Ask the team to point to the Monitoring section's main implementation, then re-run the check against it so the eight open questions can be resolved in one pass.
